items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. traded from ARI to HOU (Harrison + 7th for 2nd + 6th); was NOT EXPECTED/OUT for ARI game. Fresh start with Collins et al.
items.why: Rapoport + Schefter blockbuster confirmation; ETR listed NOT EXPECTED pre-trade.
items.implication: HOU WR room upgrade long-term; ARI targets free up (Wilson etc.). Immediate inactive ARI.
items.opportunity: HOU: targets with Collins/Dell; ARI: Michael Wilson elevated usage (Levitan noted).

items.text: David Montgomery downgraded to OUT (groin); may miss some time per coach. Woody Marks lead role.
items.why: Schefter + team announcement mid-game; ETR watching list; Ryans 'some time'.
items.implication: Sit Montgomery ROS short-term; handcuff/waiver Marks priority.
items.opportunity: Backfield vacuum for Marks (carries/RZ); reverse if Montgomery unexpectedly returns soon.

items.text: Justin Jefferson expected/will play (ACTIVE); Jordan Addison not expected/INACTIVE.
items.why: ETR FINAL UPDATE + Schefter/Rap confirmation; Jefferson scored TD wanting to play home.
items.implication: Jefferson clear start; Addison sit. Jefferson target share spikes without Addison.
items.opportunity: Jefferson routes/targets/RZ elevated; Addison out removes competition.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty will play (FINAL UPDATE from GTD/hopeful pregame workout).
items.why: ETR + Rapoport 'is a go' after plantar/ankle flare; elevated backup as precaution.
items.implication: Start but monitor snaps/workload limit possible; RB1 if full go.
items.opportunity: Carries/goal-line if healthy enough; elevated backup if limited.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase will play (FINAL/UPDATE from prior uncertainty/concussion protocol).
items.why: ETR weekend summary and live updates confirmed will play; aligned with Schefter actives.
items.implication: Start with confidence in favorable matchup; full or near-full snaps expected.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as WR1 with Higgins also in.

items.why: ETR live updates; practice progression to full.
items.implication: Startable WR2/flex; shares targets with Chase.
items.opportunity: Red-zone and intermediate routes vs MIA.

items.text: Deebo Samuel Sr. ruled OUT remainder of game (hamstring).
items.why: Schefter/Rap mid/late game ruling; ETR watching list.
items.implication: Monitor severity for next week; immediate volume to other SF pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Kittle (active), remaining WRs.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere (post strong performance).
items.why: Berry direct observation of waiver heat after run; Rapoport highlighted the run too.
items.implication: Priority add in most leagues for GB backfield upside.
items.opportunity: Carries/role expansion potential in Packers offense.

items.text: Jaylen Warren passes every test (advanced/eye) as workhorse/Ekeler-esque; coaching staffs (incl this one) refused full role pre-Dowdle injury. With Dowdle out, clear path.
items.why: Player-specific Levitan take post-Dowdle (ETR NOT EXPECTED/INACTIVE); praise usage metrics.
items.implication: Strong RB start/upgrade ROS while Dowdle sidelined; handcuff value high.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, third-down, goal-line expansion with Dowdle out.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot); ETR NOT EXPECTED.
items.why: Schefter explicit; ETR summary listed NOT EXPECTED; opened volume to Tre Harris etc.
items.implication: Sit; treat as out for fantasy. Beneficiaries in LAC WR room.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to other Chargers WRs (Harris etc.).

items.text: TJ Hockenson ruled OUT (concussion); Zay Flowers officially ACTIVE; George Kittle ACTIVE (illness).
items.why: Schefter rulings; ETR watching Hockenson + EXPECTED Flowers; Rap corroboration.
items.implication: Sit Hockenson; start Flowers/Kittle. MIN TE volume elsewhere; BAL WR full go.
items.opportunity: Flowers targets with Lamar out/Huntley; Kittle routes with Deebo limited later.

items.text: Terry McLaurin will play (FINAL; active but limited/not full go).
items.why: ETR confirmation + Schefter actives list; hamstring risk in wet conditions noted.
items.implication: Risky start/sit; prefer safer options if available due to limited expectation.
items.opportunity: Routes if in but snap share capped; Diggs already out boosts residual.

items.text: Caleb Williams officially inactive (hamstring); chance to play next week.
items.implication: Sit QB; backup situation for CHI offense volume to Swift etc.
items.opportunity: RB/WR usage may shift without him.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs best salary-adjusted value by big margin in projections; only 61.5% owned in DK single-entry double-ups despite elite spot. Must-play in cash.
items.why: Levitan cash review: expensive but unmatched value; low ownership relative to projection.
items.implication: Core start in all formats; DFS cash/GPP leverage even at high salary.
